title: Fulgor Milano — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Fulgor Milano.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Italian Performance, Accessible Luxury." Premium tier. Fulgor Milano brings Italian manufacturing to the North American market at accessible price points. Made in Milan, these pro-style ranges and wall ovens offer European convection, heavy-duty cast iron grates, and Sofia and Distinto design collections. Distributed by Tasco in Canada.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers who want Italian design without paying Bertazzoni or ILVE prices. Independent dealer brands.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Fulgor Milano:

• Made in Milan, Italy — genuine Italian manufacturing

• Pro-style design at value-luxury pricing

• European convection ovens with multiple cooking modes

• Heavy-duty cast iron continuous grates

• Tasco distributed in Canada — strong dealer support
